mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 62 degrees out at Reddan Soccer Park under clear skies. We have a waxing crescent moon tonight, and the International Space Station will be visible starting at 5:35 AM. Watch it rise over Mount Horeb and travel toward Fitchburg, reaching almost directly overhead.

The City of Verona has announced updated sewer and stormwater rates to ensure our utilities remain self-supporting and well-maintained. Additionally, we have some creative news as four students have been selected as winners for the I Voted sticker contest for the November election.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with the Epic Systems UGM today. Also happening today is trivia at both Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the downtown farmers market or trivia at the Bogey Factory.
In our weekly report, we note that on August 15, a 29-year-old Verona man was arrested for a second offence O W I after a citizen reported his reckless driving.
Today's flavor of the day is Caramel Chocolate Pecan. The shop is currently closed but will open at 10 AM, so head over then to grab a scoop.
